questions.question: In The Mosquito Coast, what does Ford’s Allie Fox haul into the jungle to build?
questions.note: He is an inventor who has had it with America. Peter Weir directed, after Witness.

questions.question: In Working Girl, Harrison Ford co-stars as Jack Trainer opposite which actor as Tess McGill?
questions.note: Griffith plays Tess, the secretary whose business idea is stolen by her boss.

questions.question: The Mosquito Coast is based on a novel by which writer?
questions.note: 1981 novel. Allie takes the family to Central America to start over.

questions.question: In Regarding Henry, what is Ford’s ruthless lawyer named?
questions.note: Mike Nichols directed. Annette Bening is his wife.

questions.question: In Regarding Henry, what happens to Ford’s lawyer at the start of the film?
questions.answer: He is shot in the head
choices: He is shot in the head
He gets amnesia from a virus
questions.note: A robbery at a convenience store. He survives, and the old Henry does not.

questions.question: Which future Star Wars director wrote the screenplay for Regarding Henry?
questions.note: Abrams wrote the 1991 drama years before directing Ford in Star Wars: The Force Awakens.

questions.question: In Presumed Innocent, what is Ford’s prosecutor named?
questions.note: Rozat “Rusty” Sabich. 1990. He investigates a murder and ends up in the dock.

questions.question: In Presumed Innocent, Ford’s prosecutor is on trial for murdering whom?
questions.answer: A colleague he had an affair with
choices: A colleague he had an affair with
questions.note: Carolyn Polhemus. His wife Barbara is still in the house. The ending is a gut punch.

questions.question: Presumed Innocent is adapted from a novel by which writer?
questions.note: Turow’s 1987 legal thriller. The movie keeps the courtroom trap.

questions.question: Which actor plays defense lawyer Sandy Stern opposite Ford in Presumed Innocent?
questions.note: Juliá plays the defense attorney who dismantles the prosecution’s case against Rusty Sabich.
